raw_text: Myanmar junta just bombed Chin State right next to the Indian border. People in Champhai, Mizoram could literally hear the explosions. The Tatmadaw is getting more brazen. How long before a bomb actually lands on Indian soil? Refugees are already flooding across. India needs to take this seriously.
